description:
Look up detailed information about an EHR (Electronic Health Record) or EMR (Electronic Medical Record) software vendor.

Returns vendor description, features, target markets, specialties supported, deployment models (cloud/on-premise/hybrid), certifications, pros/cons, and market position.

Use this tool when a user:
- Asks about a specific EHR or EMR system (Epic, Cerner, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, etc.)
- Wants to compare or evaluate EHR vendors for a practice
- Asks which EMR system a hospital or health system uses
- Wants to know the features, pricing, or target market for an EHR
- Asks about the difference between specific EHR products
- Needs information about EHR certification, integrations, or compliance

Database covers 400+ EHR/EMR vendors across all specialties and practice sizes.

name.description: EHR/EMR vendor name to look up. Examples: "Epic", "Cerner", "athenahealth", "eClinicalWorks", "Allscripts", "NextGen", "Kareo", "DrChrono"
